SC-105 REQUEST FOR COURT ORDER AND ANSWER RE: DISMISSAL IN COURT OF CLAIM AND REINSTATEMENT OF CLAIM. FILED BY PLAINTIFF MOSTOVOI, ALEX AS TO DEFENDANT PERRY, DUANE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSO // THE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION
SC-105(REQUEST FOR COURT ORDER AND ANSWER**) FILED BY DEFENDANT PERRY, DUANE

STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE CASE TO BE HEARD BY A JUDGE PRO TEM. FILED BY MOSTOVOI, ALEX PERRY, DUANE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSO // THE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF ALEX MOSTOVOI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DUANE PERRY IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS MICHAEL LEVINSON. MR. PERRY IS THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND MR. LEVINSON IS THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER OF THE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION. HONORABLE WILLIAM LYNN FINDS THAT THE PROPER DEFENDANT IN THIS MATTER IS THE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION AND THEREFORE AMENDS THE CLAIM AS PER CCP SEC 116.560 AND THE SMALL CLAIMS COURT CONSUMER LAW HANDBOOK SECTION 3.10. DEFENDANT PERRY AGREES WITH THE AMENDMENT. THE CASE AGAINST THE COURTYARD ON NOB HILL CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNER ASSOCIATION IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE PARTIES DID NOT ENGAGE IN MEDIATION AS PER CC & R 12.6. THE CASE AGAINST DEFENDANT DUANE PERRY IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
